__inputs.name: DS_ELASTICSEARCH
__inputs.label: Elasticsearch (claude telemetry index)
__inputs.description: Elasticsearch datasource pointing at the claude telemetry index

description: Inspect a single Claude Code session: pick it from the table, then follow its timeline, sub-agent fan-out, edits, tests and friction.

panels.title: Sessions in range (click a session_id to inspect)
panels.description: Every session with events in the current time range, newest last-activity first — includes still-running sessions. Clicking a session_id selects it and zooms the dashboard to the session's window.

targets.query: branch:${branch:lucene} AND repo:${repo:lucene} AND user:${user:lucene} AND host:${host:lucene}

panels.title: Session summaries (finished sessions)
panels.description: session_summary events in range. Clicking a session_id selects it (keeps the current time range — use the left table to zoom to the exact session window).

targets.query: branch:${branch:lucene} AND repo:${repo:lucene} AND user:${user:lucene} AND host:${host:lucene} AND event:session_summary

panels.title: Wall time
panels.description: From session_summary (empty until the session ends)

panels.title: Turns
panels.description: Main-loop assistant messages (session_summary)

panels.title: Total tokens
panels.description: Main loop + sub-agents, excl. cache (session_summary)

panels.title: Sub-agent tokens
panels.description: Sub-agent input + output (session_summary)

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: tool_use events in this session (respects the Agent filter)

panels.title: Edits
panels.description: Successful edit events (respects the Agent filter)

panels.title: Sub-agents spawned
panels.description: agent_use events (Task/Agent tool, workflow fan-outs; respects the Agent filter)

panels.title: Friction events
panels.description: Tool failures, compile fails and guardrail hits (respects the Agent filter)

targets.query: session_id:${session_id:lucene} AND event:(tool_failure OR compile_fail OR dangerous_bash_blocked OR protected_deny OR protected_warn OR test_integrity OR stop_gate_exhausted) AND (agent_id:${agent_id:lucene})

panels.title: Session summary record
panels.description: The raw session_summary event for the selected session (empty while the session is still running).

panels.title: Activity by agent (tool calls over time)
panels.description: One series per lane: 'main' is the main loop, every other series is a sub-agent's agent_id. Overlapping bars = sub-agents running in parallel. Join agent_id against spawned_agent_id in the spawn table below to see what each lane was asked to do.

targets.query: session_id:${session_id:lucene} AND event:tool_use AND NOT _exists_:agent_id AND (agent_id:${agent_id:lucene})

panels.title: Sub-agent spawns (agent_use)
panels.description: Every sub-agent launched in this session, in order. spawned_agent_id matches the agent_id lanes above and the agent_id column in the timeline — click one to set the Agent filter to that sub-agent. agent_id here is the *spawner* (empty = main loop), and the Agent filter applies to it, so filtering by an agent shows the spawns it made. Hover a cell and use the inspect icon to read full prompts.

panels.title: Inter-agent messages (message_send)
panels.description: SendMessage traffic during the session. agent_id is the sender (empty = main loop); the Agent filter applies to it.

panels.title: Skills invoked (skill_use)
panels.description: Skill / slash-command invocations during the session (respects the Agent filter).

panels.title: Chronological event timeline
panels.description: Every event this session shipped, oldest first (up to 2000), narrowed by the Agent filter. Detail columns are sparse because event types differ — that's expected. agent_id empty = main loop; subagent=true marks tool calls made inside a sub-agent. Hover a cell and use the inspect icon for full values.

panels.title: Edits
panels.description: Successful Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit calls (failed edits appear as tool_failure under Friction).

panels.title: Test runs
panels.description: test_run events for this session.

panels.title: Friction & guardrail events
panels.description: Tool failures, compile failures and guardrail hits during this session.

targets.query: session_id:${session_id:lucene} AND event:(tool_failure OR compile_fail OR dangerous_bash_blocked OR protected_deny OR protected_warn OR test_integrity OR stop_gate_exhausted) AND (agent_id:${agent_id:lucene})

panels.title: Tokens over time (tool_use messages)
panels.description: Token counts of the assistant messages that issued tool calls, bucketed over the session. Parallel tool calls in one message repeat that message's numbers, so treat this as shape-over-time, not an exact total — the Session overview stats carry the deduped totals.

list.name: session_id
list.label: Session
list.query: {"find": "terms", "field": "session_id", "query": "branch:${branch:lucene} AND repo:${repo:lucene} AND user:${user:lucene} AND host:${host:lucene}"}

title: Claude Code Session Inspector
